_comments.activationHealthThreshold: HP ratio where Zenkai tracking starts. 0.25 = 25% HP or lower.
_comments.maxStacks: Maximum stacks gained from normal near-death damage.
_comments.deathPreventionMaxStacks: Maximum stacks when lethal damage is survived by death prevention.
_comments.statBonusPerStack: Flat stat gain ratio per stack. 0.005 = +0.5% of the current raw stat per stack.
_comments.cooldownSeconds: Cooldown after a Zenkai is awarded.
_comments.zenkaiDecayPerUse: Each successful Zenkai loses this ratio of its boost per previous Zenkai. 0.05 = 5% less per use.
_comments.maxZenkais: Overrides the amount of usable Zenkais. Default: 10. Set 0 to use the automatic limit from zenkaiDecayPerUse. Invalid negative or above-decay values are treated as 0.
_comments.maxZenkaiReleaseBonus: Maximum additive release gained progressively from Zenkais. 0.15 means +15 release points at the final usable Zenkai.
_comments.friendlyFistStackMultiplier: Stack multiplier when damage came from a player with Friendly Fist active.
_comments.shadowDummyGiveZenkai: Whether damage caused by a DragonMineZ Shadow Dummy can contribute to Zenkai.
_comments.shadowDummyFriendlyFist: When Shadow Dummy Zenkai is enabled, treats its damage like Friendly Fist damage and applies friendlyFistStackMultiplier.
_comments.maxBonusBaseStatRatio: Maximum permanent Zenkai bonus per stat compared to the player's untransformed base stat. 1.0 caps total bonus at 100% of that base stat; 0 removes the cap.
_comments.boostedStats: DMZ stats affected by Zenkai permanent bonuses. RES is split into equal DEF and STM bonuses.
